name: @lilydesignsystem/nunjucks-gantt-chart
description: Lily Design System Nunjucks Gantt chart: a keyboard-and-pointer-accessible Gantt chart (WAI-ARIA APG Grid, row hierarchy, milestones, percent-complete, finish-to-start dependency data, keyboard-accessible edit region composing date-time-picker, drag-and-drop supplementary). Headless, SSR-safe, no CSS.
